sources.name: Open-Meteo Air Quality API (CAMS model)
sources.terms: Non-commercial open database license (CC BY 4.0). Model-based CAMS-derived data – NOT ground station readings. Attribution required for public use. AQI calculated using Indian CPCB National AQI sub-index method applied to PM2.5 and PM10 (µg/m³, hourly). Configurable TTL via AQI_TTL_SECONDS env var.
sources.attribution: Air quality forecast data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0) using Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) model by ECMWF. Sub-index AQI calculated via Indian CPCB formula.
